sections.title: Case creation handler
sections.what: Takes the submitted case details and creates a synthetic case from them.
sections.why: Likely reason: the case must exist before any other data can be attached.
sections.watch_out: Fields are converted to text without a strict rule, so bad values reach the service unless it checks them.

summary: Web address that creates a new synthetic case from submitted details.
purpose: Lets a user start a new case.
why: Likely reason: case creation is the entry point for new work.
how: Reads the request body, converts each field to text, passes them to the case service, and returns the new case. Errors are caught in a try block. A specific handling for validation errors is cut off in the source.
inputs: JSON body with district, circle, village, khata, optional khesra, and nickname.
outputs: The created case detail, or an error response.
risks: Fields are converted to text without strict checks here, so empty or unexpected values are passed to the service. The error branch is cut off.
debug: Look at the validation messages in the case service if a create request is rejected.
